title: i18n: French is not a platform locale, so a user whose locale is `fr` reads English `sys_user` labels (Home feed field labels)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the sys_user fold dev (PR #28065, os-dev report on #27858); it carries #27869 acceptance (b). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade, and whether a fifth platform locale is wanted.

Reach: every user whose `sys_user.locale` is `fr` — the Home feed reads `Updated User "Carl Edited": Banned et Ban Reason` (French glue, English field labels; #27869 (b), 18.3.0 RC walkthrough).
Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/platform-objects` bundles and the root `i18n:extract`), with HotCRM's declared locales in the question.

## What the code does (read, not measured)

`platform-objects` ships `en` / `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` only (`setup.translation.ts` `SetupAppTranslations`; the root `i18n:extract --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES`), and HotCRM declares the same four. `fr` exists only in the console's own strings (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/fr.ts`). So the console speaks French around metadata labels that stay English.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

Decide whether `fr` becomes a fifth platform locale (every platform bundle, through the generator) or whether the console should not offer a UI locale the platform metadata cannot follow. Either way, the two sides agree on one locale list.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `French`, `fr` locale, `fifth locale`, translation bundle: only #27869 (the parent row). **New.**

Links back: #27869, #27521, PR #28065
